sources.title: Ardoq Named a Leader in 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Enterprise Architecture Tools
Bizzdesign Announces New Leadership Team Following Merger With MEGA and Alfabet

items.title: The category has moved beyond static EA repositories into enterprise transformation platforms
items.summary: The leading vendors position around continuous transformation, strategy-to-execution traceability, business architecture, application portfolio management, process context, risk, and AI governance.
items.implication: Model the domain around connected transformation decisions rather than diagram storage alone.

items.title: Application portfolio management remains the common entry use case
items.summary: Vendors consistently market application inventory, rationalization, lifecycle risk, cost optimization, technology standards, and modernization planning as practical starting points.
items.implication: Keep application portfolio catalog, rationalization, lifecycle, cost, and risk scoring as first-class product bricks.

items.title: Business stakeholder engagement is now central to EA product value
items.summary: The strongest products emphasize broad participation through surveys, dashboards, accessible views, collaboration, presentations, and business-friendly language.
items.implication: Model stakeholder surveys, role-based dashboards, work queues, and AI explanations as core bricks, not auxiliary features.

items.title: Integration freshness and data quality determine whether architecture insight is trusted
items.summary: EA platforms win when they can ingest existing enterprise data, synchronize with operating systems, and make source lineage and quality visible.
items.implication: Treat import, synchronization, telemetry, and model quality as foundational product bricks.

items.title: AI governance is emerging as a high-value architecture use case
items.summary: Vendors now highlight AI governance, AI agent discovery, AI-driven insight, and responsible transformation as a natural extension of architecture traceability.
items.implication: Represent AI insight, AI governance readiness, control mapping, and evidence review in both customer jobs and product capabilities.

items.title: Private EA specialists disclose customer scale and outcome metrics more often than revenue
items.summary: Public business metrics are uneven in the category. Bizzdesign disclosed combined revenue after the MEGA and Alfabet combination, Orbus disclosed customer counts and SaaS growth, and Avolution disclosed survey and outcome indicators.
items.implication: Use conservative KPI targets and preserve source reporting scopes in competition analysis.

items.title: The buyer is cross-functional even when enterprise architecture owns the tool
items.summary: CIOs, enterprise architects, portfolio leaders, business architects, risk leaders, security teams, transformation offices, and application owners all shape adoption.
items.implication: Segment customers by decision outcome: technology portfolio, EA practice, transformation portfolio, and risk/compliance governance.

items.title: Practitioner adoption determines whether the architecture model stays trusted
items.summary: EA platforms create durable value only when enterprise architects can use them in daily modeling, impact analysis, review, and stakeholder-guidance work without duplicating effort in diagrams and spreadsheets.
items.implication: Model Enterprise Architect as a first-class customer persona with practitioner productivity, review quality, and guidance throughput KPIs.
